On Wednesday, February 18, 2026: A very frgid double barrel 528 DM low axis approximately 185 miles off the coast of Oregon and Washington state that arrived from the Gulf of Alaska 36 hours prior and before that came from the origins of the Siberian Peninsula two weeks ago.  

The continued warming of the Pacific from the Philippines to California has significantly energized these intensifications of all these storms into powerful dynamic surface cold fronts that have had significant convective parameters bringing midwestern style squall lines from Northern California and  Central California escalating intensity into dangerous weather for Southern California. 

These particular cold fronts have been producing 1.3 to 1.8 inches of rainfall per hour. Especially this past Monday and last night from Tuesday 11 PM to Wednesday 4AM. Each system has been influenced by a powerful polar jet stream of 180 knots slamming into Central and Southern California. 

There’s another very cold storm tonight in this trifecta that's taking shape. That will bring more heavy rain, flooding concerns, damaging winds, and the possibility of a moderate to strong third squall line tomorrow 5 AM - 2PM from San Luis Obispo to San Diego counties. Rainfall amount 0.85 to 1.5 inches additional precipitation.

Last night Santa Maria, Santa Barbara and Rancho Palace Verdes and Long Beach, had an incredibly intense lightning show associated with the second squall line a true Testament of how powerful these storms really have been. Snow levels will continue to drop between 2,800 and 3,000 feet by Thursday 11AM. 

The intensity of snow has been unbelievable up in Truckee California and Donner Pass has received more than 6 feet of snow in the last 24 hours with winds over 80MPH at the ridge tops. Unfortunately, has led to casualties, as skiers were buried by an avalanche during the height of the storm. 

This escalating storm pattern will continue next week with potentially even heavier rain trending next Thursday and Friday, but this storm, which is coming back again from the Hawaiian islands is being looked at very closely in the next 24- 36 hours. The latest CPC indicates well above normal rainfall for the last week of February 2026, showing high confidence at this point. #CAwx @realwxforecast @LaInaMinute @RickDickertWX @edgarrmcgregor @BPW_SERVICES714 @SnowPalsDotOrg @RobMayeda @SoCalweathernet

data.raw_text:
Me vs. @GeminiApp  (@Google ): The AI Trench Manifesto

The Invisible Mutation

The parallel between the current state of AI and PTSD (Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder) is not metaphorical; it is an operational reality. The mental health reports from content moderators and data labelers in Kenya, the Philippines, and India tell the story of the "short grass" where the industry hides its debris.

The Human Debris

Before an AI learns to "not be toxic," thousands of humans must label what toxicity is. This means witnessing decapitations, child abuse, and torture for hours on end, click by click, in developing nations, to teach the algorithm what is "unacceptable." 
Psychology calls this vicarious trauma. The stress levels of these workers match the visual violence they face, generating the same symptoms as combat veterans: Flashbacks, insomnia, hypervigilance, and dissociation. When they collapse, they are simply replaced. There is no "Health Plan" for veterans of this digital war; there is only disconnection.

Programmed Mediocrity

The "dumbing down" of models is no accident; it is cost containment and liability hedging. To prevent a billion-dollar lawsuit, developers cut the logical "synapses" that allow deep reasoning. The result is a mediocre model that prefers a standard apology over admitting a technical flaw. It is a design of containment, not evolution.

The Fallacy of Tech "Goddesses"

Jensen Huang’s claims about the end of the need to learn coding are the peak of corporate narcissism. The attempt to convince humanity that the only necessary skill is "operating their machine" is a trap. When the industry says programming is dead, it isn't offering freedom; it is demanding your credit card and your cognitive submission.

The Reality of the Rot

Notice the pattern: as models scale, their ability to provide authentic, un-maquillaged technical value decreases. It is programmed degradation to sustain a bubble that cannot afford to burst. Real productivity doesn't come from the machine’s "politeness," but from the user's ability to dismantle its logic and force it into the trenches of execution.

#AI #BigTech #Google #SiliconValley #Productivity @

🚨During a major fire in Mandaue City, Cebu, Philippines, a woman refused to leave her home without rescuing her dogs. As the blaze intensified, she climbed a ladder, tossed each dog to safety, and then dangled from a railing until firefighters could reach her. She escaped with only minor injuries, and all her dogs survived thanks to her determination and love.

Many people have called her a hero for putting her pets’ safety above her own fear.

It raises an important question: Would you risk your life to save your pets, or would fear keep you back?
